issues.description: Return type of Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents() is inconsistent: the problem statement and UML specify `getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int`, but the solution implements `public StudentCount getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. This changes the required method signature and will confuse/block students who implement an `int` return type per specification (and would not match the reference solution API).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the required signature across all artifacts. Preferred: change the solution to `public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()` returning `numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents` and remove StudentCount usage. Alternatively, if StudentCount is intended, update the problem statement/UML (and template TODO text) to specify `StudentCount getTotalNumberOfStudents()` and explain the wrapper type.
